The person asks in their own words, and the story says plainly what the assistant understood and did.
Use the noun "peach", the verb "know" and the adjective "hungry" somewhere (any form of them is fine, like a plural or the past tense).
Include a number written in words, like twenty-five.
Use simple, everyday English. Write only the text itself: no title, no notes, and no angle brackets.
